answer: Provenance is a glacier: slow to form, and only the oldest layers carry weight. A new identity settles on a ledge of little standing, and every payment it makes must descend through a signal channel whose age the receiver can see. Each new identity starts a fresh channel instead of inheriting one, so splitting a wallet into n accounts resets the clock n times and none reach useful depth inside a season, while the k-th channel opening an operator sponsors costs k squared in escrow. Pooling fails too: a channel lent to another identity voids its age and restarts at zero.
